item.title: Berkshire Hathaway Completes $9.7 Billion Acquisition Of OxyChem From Occidental
item.description: Berkshire Hathaway announced it has completed its acquisition of OxyChem from Occidental for $9.7 billion, subject to customary post-closing purchase price adjustments, bringing a large-scale U.S.-based chemical producer into Berkshire’s group of operating businesses. item.title: SoftBank Completes Additional $22.5 Billion Investment In OpenAI
item.description: SoftBank Group announced it has completed an additional $22.5 billion investment in OpenAI, marking the second closing of its previously announced commitment to invest up to $40 billion and bringing the company’s total SoftBank-backed investment in the AI company to $30 billion. The second closing happened on December 26, 2025. The post SoftBank Completes Additional $22.5 Billion Investment In OpenAI appeared first on Pulse 2.0.

item.title: NeoGenomics Adds Diagnostics Executive Jack Kenny To Board
item.description: NeoGenomics has appointed diagnostics and laboratory services veteran John P. “Jack” Kenny to its Board of Directors, adding a senior commercial and operating leader as the company positions itself for what it describes as emerging opportunities in next-generation cancer testing. Kenny fills a seat vacated by Alison Hannah, MD, who is rotating off the board after more than a decade of service. item.title: Lee Enterprises Announces $50 Million Strategic Equity Investment, Board Transition, And CEO Retirement
item.description: Lee Enterprises announced it has entered into a definitive stock purchase agreement for a $50 million strategic equity investment in its common stock, a transaction the company framed as a board-directed effort to strengthen its balance sheet, improve its capital structure, and reset leadership and governance as it moves into what it called its next phase. item.title: Ooma Completes Acquisition of Phone.com For About $23.2 Million
item.description: Ooma, which provides a smart communications platform for businesses and consumers, said it has completed its previously announced acquisition of Phone.com, a cloud-based business communications provider focused on small and mid-sized organizations. The deal closed for approximately $23.2 million in cash, subject to customary working capital adjustments. item.title: Pinnacle And Synovus Complete Merger To Form $117 Billion Regional Bank
item.description: Pinnacle Financial Partners (now trading on the New York Stock Exchange under “PNFP”) has completed its previously announced merger with Synovus Financial, creating a combined regional banking company with an estimated $117.2 billion in assets as of September 30, 2025. The combined organization is operating as a single bank holding company under the name Pinnacle Financial Partners, marking the close of a transaction the companies first announced on July 24, 2025. item.title: Bain Capital Launches $344 Million Bid For South Korea-Based Echo Marketing
item.description: Bain Capital has agreed to acquire South Korea-based Echo Marketing in a transaction valued at roughly $344 million, combining a negotiated purchase of a controlling stake with a tender offer for the remaining shares as revealed in a DART filing. item.description: Sandisk announced it has appointed Alexander R. item.title: McCormick Takes Majority Control Of McCormick de Mexico With $750 Million Purchase
item.description: McCormick & Company announced it has completed the acquisition of an additional 25% ownership interest in McCormick de Mexico from Grupo Herdez, increasing McCormick’s ownership in the joint venture to 75% and giving it a controlling stake in the business.
